about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the evocative world of Primal Planet through its original soundtrack—an emotional, cinematic score that echoes the journey of a prehistoric warrior fighting to reunite with his family.

From quiet, atmospheric soundscapes to pulse-pounding combat themes, each track reflects the emotional highs and lows of the game’s touching narrative and dangerous world.
Composed to accompany exploration, tension, and moments of raw humanity, this soundtrack blends ancient percussion, haunting flutes, and ambient textures to create a deeply immersive experience, both in and out of the game.

Experience the wild. Feel the stakes. Hear the heart of Primal Planet.
